title: Fetchlinks source checkpoint (contract v1)
description: How far a source has been read. Publishers apply checkpoints last-write-wins by observed_at so replaying an older batch cannot regress a cursor.

source_key.description: Natural key of the stream within the source: a subreddit name, a Mastodon instance name, or 'timeline'.

cursor.description: Opaque provider cursor. Always a string, even when the provider returns a numeric-looking value.

source_url.description: Instance URL for multi-instance sources such as Mastodon; null otherwise.
